name: Jorma Taccone
bio: Jorma Christopher Taccone (pronounced yorma tuh-cone-nee) (born March 19, 1977) is an American comedy writer-actor-director. Taccone is one third of the sketch comedy troupe The Lonely Island along with childhood friends Andy Samberg and Akiva Schaffer. He has directed the films MacGruber and Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping.
